dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structures feature dark, high-contrast outer perimeters with irregular, sub-polygonal geometries. The gradient transition from the dark exterior to the lighter interior is characterized by a sharp, high-frequency edge transition followed by a diffuse, low-intensity interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity pixels are predominantly confined within the interiors of the macro-annuli. Independent high-intensity clusters without internal gradients are sparsely distributed, appearing as small, amorphous pixel groups localized primarily near the posterior-dorsal boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent lateral macro-annuli form a non-uniform, irregular pentagonal spatial arrangement. Geometric relationships between centroids indicate varying distances, with a higher concentration of keypoints in the mid-lateral region compared to the dorsal midline.
